description: This file is a Markdown documentation source describing the ElectronApplication class in Playwright's API. It provides method signatures, events, usage examples, and documentation comments for controlling and interacting with Electron applications via Playwright.

classes.name: ElectronApplication
classes.description: Represents an instance of a running Electron application with methods to interact, evaluate, control windows, and handle events within the Electron environment.

methods.name: console
methods.description: Event emitted when JavaScript within the Electron main process calls console API methods, e.g., `console.log`.

methods.name: window
methods.description: Event emitted for every window that is created and loaded in Electron, providing a Playwright [Page] object for automation.

methods.name: browserWindow
methods.description: Returns the BrowserWindow object corresponding to a given Playwright [Page].

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Executes a function in the Electron application context and returns its serializable result.

methods.name: evaluateHandle
methods.description: Executes a function in the Electron application context and returns a JSHandle to the result.

methods.name: firstWindow
methods.description: Convenience method to wait for and return the first Electron application window ([Page]).

methods.name: process
methods.description: Returns the main process for this Electron application.

methods.name: waitForEvent
methods.description: Waits for a specific event in the Electron application and resolves when the predicate returns true.

methods.name: windows
methods.description: Returns all open Electron windows as an array of [Page] objects.
